sources.title: Kimi (AI) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Kimi is an artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot and series of large language models developed by Chinese company Moonshot AI. Its Kimi K3, released July 2026, is the largest open weights model at 2.8 trillion parameters.
